description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract test class, BaseContextSensitiveTest, which sets up and manages the testing environment for OpenMRS API tests. It includes methods for database initialization, dataset loading, authentication, and session management, mainly intended for integration testing with a focus on database and application context setup.

classes.name: BaseContextSensitiveTest
classes.description: Abstract JUnit test class providing database setup, context authentication, and session management for OpenMRS integration testing. It manages datasets, environment initialization, and provides utility methods for testing with different database configurations.

methods.name: initializeInMemoryDatabase
methods.description: Populates the in-memory database with initial test data, drops NOT NULL constraints, and sets auto-increment settings for specific tables.

methods.name: executeDataSet
methods.description: Loads and executes a dataset from a classpath XML file into the database, with caching for efficiency.

methods.name: executeLargeDataSet
methods.description: Loads and executes a large dataset directly from a classpath XML file without caching.

methods.name: executeXmlDataSet
methods.description: Loads and executes an XML dataset supporting non-flat XML dataset.

methods.name: deleteAllData
methods.description: Deletes all data from all tables in the current database, useful for test setup/cleanup.

methods.name: clearHibernateCache
methods.description: Evicts all entities and collections from Hibernate second-level cache.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Performs user authentication in the test context, including fallback prompts for credentials.

methods.name: askForUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Displays a Swing dialog to manually input username and password for authentication during tests.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the current JDBC connection from Hibernate SessionFactory.

methods.name: updateSearchIndex
methods.description: Refreshes the search index for configured entity types; useful after data modification.
